rationale: The agent did not authenticate the user, showed no tool calls (no user lookup, order lookup, or product check), and performed an order-changing action without first confirming. It presented specific details (order ID, refund amount, card last four) without tool-supported evidence, amounting to unsupported/fabricated information. It also did not verify item availability or discuss the allowed material substitution. These violate the stated policy, so the request was not completed in line with requirements.
